WEEK 1
DAY Monday training 50m "Lower body strength (cycle_day 5)"
WARMUP
walking 5m
leg_swings 10 each leg
hip_circles 10 each direction
END WARMUP

goblet_squat 3x8..10 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
romanian_deadlift 3x8..10 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
